fields.name: trackWidth
fields.tooltip: Full width of the track in meters. Drives the ship's steering clamp, the pad placement bounds and the road meshes (which are authored for 60 m and stretch proportionally). Regenerate to see it.

fields.name: straightness
fields.tooltip: Chance that a straight knot starts a banked sweep: 100% = a dead straight line, 0% = a sweep at every chance the features leave room for. The sweeps' rate, arc and bank live below. Regenerate to see it.

fields.name: featureTable
fields.tooltip: One entry per track feature kind (jump ramps, loops, tubes). Every feature step draws one entry by probability; the sliders auto-rebalance to always total 100%.

fields.name: featureSpacing
fields.tooltip: Metres of track between feature steps (min, max), before each entry's own minimum spacing, footprint and exclusion are added.

fields.name: elevationEnabled
fields.tooltip: Let the road rise and fall. Off = the flat track (and no random draws, so a seed reproduces the flat layout exactly).

fields.name: elevationBand
fields.tooltip: How far above or below the start height the road may wander, metres. Inside it the pull below leans the grade home; outside it the next knot always heads back.

fields.name: maxGrade
fields.tooltip: Steepest grade the road takes, degrees. Keep it well under vertical — the pose frame needs a tangent that is never straight up.

fields.name: maxGradeStepPerKnot
fields.tooltip: Most the grade may change from one knot to the next, degrees. Knots are 300–420 m apart, so 3° per knot is a swell kilometres long — raise it and the road starts to feel bumpy.

fields.name: baselinePull
fields.tooltip: How strongly the grade leans back toward the baseline as the road drifts off it: 0 = a free random walk inside the band, 1 = a full step's worth of pull at the band's edge.

fields.name: turnRateRange
fields.tooltip: Heading change per knot during a sweep (min, max), degrees, rolled per sweep. Knots are 300–420 m apart: 30°/knot is a radius of roughly 700 m. The chance a straight knot STARTS a sweep is the generator's straightness knob (100% = never).

fields.name: turnArcRange
fields.tooltip: Total heading change of a sweep (min, max), degrees, rolled per sweep. A sweep lasts arc / rate knots.

fields.name: minStraightKnots
fields.tooltip: Straight knots kept after a sweep before the next may start.

fields.name: alternateTurnChance
fields.tooltip: Chance the next sweep goes the other way. Keeps the road from spiralling.

fields.name: maxHeadingDrift
fields.tooltip: Once the heading has wandered this far from the start direction, the next sweep always heads back, so the road ahead never doubles over the road behind.

fields.name: unbankedSweepChance
fields.tooltip: Chance a sweep is authored FLAT instead of banked: no bank, the ship's grip is tested against its speed (too fast and it slides outward), and the OUTER edge has no wall. Banked sweeps always hold. 0 = every sweep is banked and safe (and no random draw, so a seed reproduces the all-banked layout). Regenerate to see it.

fields.name: openStraightChance
fields.tooltip: Chance a straight run of road has NO walls on either side: drift or dash too close to the edge and the ship drops off. Rolled once per straight run; only level road well clear of features, landing zones and banked sweeps can be open. 0 = every straight is walled (and no random draw). Regenerate to see it.

fields.name: bankEnabled
fields.tooltip: Roll the road into its sweeps. Off = the road stays level through every turn.

fields.name: maxBankAngle
fields.tooltip: Steepest bank the road takes, degrees (outer edge up). 80 is a wall the ship rides like an oval's banking; keep it under 90.

fields.name: bankPerDegreeOfTurn
fields.tooltip: Degrees of bank per degree of heading change at a knot. 4 with a 20°/knot sweep is the full 80° wall; a gentler sweep banks less.

fields.name: maxBankStepPerKnot
fields.tooltip: Most the bank may change from one knot to the next, degrees. 45 rolls a flat road up to the wall in two knots and back down in two; it also sets how many knots the road needs to unwind before a feature.

fields.name: levelLeadDistance
fields.tooltip: Extra level road kept before every feature spot, metres, on top of the knots the current bank needs to unwind. Features (loops, tubes, ramps) always start on level road.

fields.name: prefab
fields.tooltip: Optional model spawned instead of the code-built ramp. Authored as a UNIT ramp (1 m wide, 1 m tall lip, 1 m long, foot at its origin, rising toward +Z); it is scaled to the ramp's width, lip height and length. Colliders are stripped — detection is analytic.

fields.name: definition
fields.tooltip: What the feature is and how it behaves (a JumpDefinition for ramps). Cloned at play, so the debug menu never edits the asset.

fields.name: probability
fields.tooltip: Share of every feature roll this entry wins. The table always sums to 100%.

fields.name: minSpacing
fields.tooltip: Least metres of track between this feature and the next one, on top of its footprint and exclusion.

fields.name: multiplier
fields.tooltip: Takeoff boost as a multiple of GameSettings.powerUpSpeedBoost (1 = a green orb's worth).

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Tint of the code-built ramp (prefabs keep their own materials) and of its debug rows.
